_note: This is a Detectron2 LazyCall configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or CLI entry points. It patches an inherited config to define a PACO Cascade R-CNN model with ViT-B backbone for 531-class attribute-aware instance segmentation. All tooling is declarative config mutation.
review_PACOCascadeROIHeads_config: review the PACOCascadeROIHeads config with 3 cascade stages and escalating BBox transform weights
review_FastRCNNConvFCHead_config: review the FastRCNNConvFCHead config with 4 conv layers and LN normalization for cascade stages
review_FastRCNNOutputLayers_config: review the FastRCNNOutputLayers config with sigmoid CE, fed loss, and class-agnostic bbox regression
review_Matcher_config: review the Matcher config with escalating IoU thresholds of 0.5, 0.6, and 0.7 for cascade stages
review_train_eval_period_config: review the train config that sets eval_period to 5000000 iterations for cascade training
